title: HATCH DWG rational spline weight handoff fast slice

implementation.behavior: For each rational HATCH spline control, read a bounded finite BD after the 2D point and store it in both DRW_Spline::weightlist and legacy DRW_Coord::z. Preserve XY. No DWG writer authority change.
testControls: Scratch-authored ODA-order AC1018 rational zero-fit vector
Scratch-authored ODA-order AC1027 rational one-fit vector with tangents
Quarter-circle weights 1, sqrt(0.5), 1 and distinct non-unit weights 1, 0.5, 1.5
Independent literal-field decoding and exact control/weight assertions
Truncated final weight transactional refusal and parser-instance retry
Following edge, boundary path, object callback, and following LINE sentinel checks
DWG write/read and ASCII/Binary DXF group-42 export/readback
Zero elevation and no geometric control-Z leakage
implementation.testScannerCorrection: Standalone dxfReader now enables DIMSTYLE name/reference compatibility and wide handle lexemes to match the normal library import scope; previous false failure stopped in TABLES before ENTITIES.
